710480101.text: Ah, it's you. Well, are you here to brave The Chasm by any chance?

710480103.text: Paimon's never heard of any commission like that...

710480104.text: Oh, uh, you don't know about the Guild's commissions yet? Sorry, that's my mistake.

710480105.text: Well, The Chasm has been closed for a long time now. No one can go in without the Qixing's say-so, not even the Adventurers' Guild.

710480108.text: Well, we wouldn't dream of being a bother to the people at Yujing Terrace. It would be a counterproductive thing to do, messing with pre-established policy like that.

710480109.text: Even Ms. Ganyu, who seems like the most amicable of the bunch, would probably just smile at us and say "why don't you have some tea while you wait here?"

710480110.text: And then she'll leave you hanging for most of the day, until you start wondering whether she'd forgotten all about you till she was nearly off from work...

710480111.text: Hmph, and as we all know, Ms. Ganyu never gets off work.

710480113.text: That certainly does sound like a very Ganyu-esque way of refusing.

710480114.text: Either way, this means that Ms. Katheryne isn't going to be giving out any commissions about The Chasm anytime soon. Instead, we've got to find more... convenient people to help us out in private.

710480116.text: Yes, like for example, miners from Huishan Hall, members of the Millelith, staff at the Ministry of Civil Affairs. They can get passes to go in more easily, and...

710480118.text: Well... So what I'm saying is, O valiant hero who saved Liyue from the sea monster, yet seems to have nothing to do all day every day, surely you can talk to the Millelith on our behalf?

710480119.text: No idea who you're talking about.

710480121.text: C'mon, she was definitely talking about you!

710480122.text: Don't play dumb. Who do you think I'm talking about, Rex Lapis?

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for Muning, the Ministry of Civil Affairs' specialist

710440501.text: Could you tell me more about The Chasm?

710440502.text: Right, so about the Chasm... If you don't intend to leave just yet, you're free to explore the area a bit. But please do keep your actions within the remit of Liyue's laws and statutes.

710440503.text: I should mention, though, that there is a place that I highly recommend you avoid.

710440504.text: For example, the great mine in the center of The Chasm has had a Seven-Star Array cast over it... By which I mean exactly what I say — it is a seal placed over the area by the Qixing.

710440505.text: Well, that's quite the clear explanation.

710440506.text: As for the weak... I mean, focal point of the array, it lies in the Bedrock Keys surrounding the area. These were placed by the Qixing themselves. Connected in series, they affix the energy flowing through the array.

710440507.text: The area around the Bedrock Keys has seen an abnormal amount of Geo elemental coalescences. It's almost as if the "thing" beneath yearns to finally emerge...

710440508.text: ...Uh, never mind me, I was just talking to myself. So yes, that's how things are. Please do not — and I repeat, do not — go near the Seven-Star Array, and don't even think about going down there to explore.

710440509.text: The Bedrock Keys are definitely not losing structural integrity, and the surrounding areas are most certainly not plagued by any strange Geo elemental convergences. So please, don't you think of doing anything at all.

710440511.text: Hmph, I know what you're going to ask.

710440512.text: There are most certainly no precious treasures down there, nor are there any prehistoric fossils to be had. And banish any thoughts you have about giant ancient ruins... Yes, please do not bear any fruitless expectations toward this place.

710440513.text: The way you're saying all this is super suspicious!

710440514.text: Not even mushrooms will grow down there! Nor are there wish-granting stones! And there are definitely no sailors who grow strong just by eating mushrooms! Again, do not get your hopes up!

710440515.text: Uh, yeah, sure! There's no need to be so fierce...

710440520.text: I suggest that you go speak to Zhiqiong first. She is an adventurer hired by the Ministry and was once a miner here. She knows The Chasm's geography like the back of her hand...

710440521.text: Also, let me write you a certification real quick. When she sees it, she'll know that you're trustworthy.

710440522.text: That said, I must warn you that Zhiqiong is definitely not the sort of person who has trouble standing still, and definitely has no thoughts of undoing the array and having a look underground.

710440523.text: So there's no way that she would ever put a team of idle adventurers together to brazenly enter hazardous areas! As such, you can forget about asking her to help you enter The Chasm's mines.

710480201.text: You're back. The Adventurers' Guild welcomes you.

710480203.text: What, you want me to tell you what's in there? Who knows, seriously?

710480204.text: Some say that the some miners dug up what they call "Wish Granter," but that they got the opposite of what they wished for when they wished upon it. Others say that they dug up some old dragon-king's tail down there. All tales as tall as mountains, of course.

710480205.text: Really, there's no point asking me about The Chasm. I'm not actually sure what happened there either. Just go ask Muning — this was also one of the Ministry's requirements, by the way.

710480207.text: *cough* Well, you can see the people who depend on The Chasm for their livelihood everywhere you go out there. I'm sure you don't mind spending time interviewing them, but I've got Guild business to attend to.

710480209.text: Oh, him? Heh. I suspect that the Ministry sent him out to The Chasm to get him to shape up a bit.

710480210.text: He's pretty good at what he does, alright, but he's one cocky kid as well. You can't have that kind of flighty character in the Ministry, you know? So yeah. The Chasm might help him grow up a bit.

710480212.text: Yeah, sure. Oh, right... Ad astra abyssosque!
